resetLink.question: Make a one-time password reset link for {{email}}? Any earlier link stops working.
resetLink.hint: Send this link to {{email}} yourself (the server sends no email). It works once and expires {{when}}. Using it signs them out everywhere.
resetLink.error: Could not make a reset link

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: For {{email}}. After this you are signed out everywhere and sign in with the new password.
reset.missing: This page needs a reset link
reset.missingBody: Open the full link your organization owner sent you. If you do not have one, ask an owner to make a reset link from Settings > Members.
reset.invalid: This reset link does not work
reset.invalidBody: It was already used, has expired, or was replaced by a newer one. Ask your organization owner for a new link.
reset.hint: At least 12 characters. A long phrase of a few words works well.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.

captcha.label: Prove you are human
captcha.loadError: The captcha could not load. Check your connection or ad blocker, then reload the page.
captcha.noSiteKey: Sign-up needs a captcha but the server has no site key set. Ask the server owner to set HEIMDALL_CAPTCHA_SITEKEY.
